specification.objective: Support explicit local manual editing of proposed compaction entries with backend-enforced constraints.

requirements.statement: Provide editable entry list with split/merge/delete and reversible view switching.
Calculate local counts and reduction; require final confirmation before applying any manually edited proposal.
Backend enforces nonempty, unique, entry caps, 60%-budget, delimiter safety and stale fingerprint while using Hermes public apply_batch.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Provide editable entry list with split/merge/delete and reversible view switching. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Calculate local counts and reduction; require final confirmation before applying any manually edited proposal. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

Backend enforces nonempty, unique, entry caps, 60%-budget, delimiter safety and stale fingerprint while using Hermes public apply_batch. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
